description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes related to pretty-printing commit information in a version control system, including commit formats, context configurations, and formatting functions.

methods.name: userformat_find_requirements
methods.description: Determines which items are needed based on the user-specified format string.

methods.name: pp_commit_easy
methods.description: Shortcut for invoking pretty_print_commit without full context.

methods.name: pp_user_info
methods.description: Formats user and date information from a line into a string buffer.

methods.name: pp_email_subject
methods.description: Formats the subject line of a commit message.

methods.name: pp_remainder
methods.description: Formats the remaining part of a commit message with indentation.

methods.name: repo_format_commit_message
methods.description: Creates a formatted commit message based on a given format and context.

methods.name: get_commit_format
methods.description: Parses arguments to fill in revision info.

methods.name: pretty_print_commit
methods.description: Formats a commit message according to the context.

methods.name: format_subject
methods.description: Replaces line breaks in a message with a specified separator.

methods.name: commit_format_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a commit format produces an empty output.

methods.name: format_sanitized_subject
methods.description: Sanitizes a commit message for filename use.

methods.name: has_non_ascii
methods.description: Checks if text contains non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: format_set_trailers_options
methods.description: Sets options for processing trailers in commit messages.

methods.name: show_ident_date
methods.description: Displays date and timezone info from an ident_split structure.
